## Episode Thesis

Interview with Joakim Tengzelius, CEO and co-founder of the serial acquirer Hasko, ahead of its planned listing on Nasdaq Stockholm. He describes a decentralised model that buys niche Nordic product companies with long track records, EBITA margins above 15%, low working capital and low capex. The group reports about 21% EBITA margin and about 10% annual organic growth from 2024 to Q3 2026. The tone is constructive and educational, with Lifco, Lagercrantz, Constellation Software and Danaher cited as role models, but no buy or sell views are given.
